svg.text: Dual Encoder Architecture with Pre-trained InstaNovo Backbone
Two-stage pipeline: contrastive retrieval (Stage 1) + decoder rescoring (Stage 2)

g.text: Loaded from checkpoint · Trained on millions of PSMs
(length K, e.g., M A L K G ...)
L = ½ [ CE(e_s · e_p^⊤ / τ, labels) + CE(e_p · e_s^⊤ / τ, labels) ]
Positive pairs pulled together · Negative pairs pushed apart · Learnable temperature τ ∈ [0.04, 5.0]

text.tspan: L = number of spectrum peaks · K = peptide sequence length · D = model hidden dim · E = embedding dim · N = number of transformer layers · T = L+1 or K+1 (after CLS prepend)
